title: Spectacular
body:
This app has been driving me crazy since they uploaded it.
At first I was just not using it because I got used to the old one.
But this one the has multi uses as the newest development of withdrawing cash from the ATM by using the app is amazing, totally unique.
Also, The latest update of the international transfers is brilliant, I am student studying abroad, I always concern regarding the transfer I use to do transfer and it takes from 3-5 working days which makes my life harder because of the long time for me to receive the money; by updating the app I was bit underestimating the concept of the “fast transfer” till I tried it today, and by the end of the day, I had my payment in my abroad bank. (Much faster;))
Thanks ADIB, as there are rapid developments it make no concerns or troubles for the customer.
